title: Chapter Wrap-up & Mixed Problems

hero.headline: Real Numbers — Full Recap
hero.subtext: Sab concepts ek saath practice karo — Division Lemma se leke Decimal Expansion tak.

story.text: Ye lesson chapter ka mixed-review hai — board exam mein Real Numbers se aksar HCF/LCM word problems aur irrational proof pooche jaate hain.

explanation.content: 1. Euclid's Division Lemma: a = bq + r, 0 ≤ r < b
2. Euclid's Algorithm: HCF = last non-zero remainder
3. Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: unique prime factorization

examples.problem: Do buses 60 min aur 90 min mein ek round trip karti hain. Agar dono 8 AM ko saath start hui, to wo dobara saath kab milengi?
steps: Ye LCM ka question hai: LCM(60, 90)
Answer: 11 AM ko dobara saath milengi

questions.question: Teen ghante ke intervals mein baj rahi teen bells ek saath 6, 8, aur 12 minute ke gaps par bajti hain. Wo dobara ek saath kitne minute baad bajengi?
questions.explanation: LCM(6,8,12) = 24. Ye classic LCM word problem hai.

questions.question: Concept ko uski definition se match karo

notes: HCF/LCM word problems mein 'together again' → LCM, 'max equal groups' → HCF
Irrational proof ka structure yaad rakho: assume rational → contradiction → conclude irrational
Denominator factorize karke decimal type turant pata chal jaata hai
summary: Real Numbers chapter complete! Ab tum HCF, LCM, irrational proofs, aur decimal expansion — sab confidently solve kar sakte ho.
